data.long_meaning: Derived from the Spanish word 'rey', meaning 'king'. In Christian tradition, this name can symbolize spiritual leadership and royalty in the kingdom of God. The name Rey carries the meaning “Royal, King” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rey usually hope their child will grow to embody royal, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rey total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
